claims.statement: For every nonempty ordinary arity-2,3,4 path-star profile, put W(X)=sum_i r_i A_i(X), counting each original private-tip deletion with its original multiplicity. For every natural k with 1<=k and 2k<=N+2, integer-zero-extended coefficients satisfy W[k+1] C[k-1]<=W[k] C[k].
claims.scope: Guarded lower-half shifted C-to-weighted-tip-deck comparison only; zero-extended coefficient predicate with 1<=k and 2k<=N+2. It does not itself impose actual first-descent eligibility or current-p strict selectors, nor assert selected payment or MASS. Any payment application must separately retain actual least first descent x, x+2<=p, 3p<2alpha+1, 2p<=alpha, current-p strict selectors, and original tip multiplicities r_i.
claims.reason: The branch-addition recurrence is correct, including its signed -NzE term, and the ULC surplus is a correctly directed sufficient condition with positive denominator. Independent exact boundary/interior checks and handoff controls are bounded evidence; no universal surplus estimate or guarded failure was established. Keep the registered weighted comparison OPEN.

limitations: The exact checks cover eight profiles at selected guarded ranks plus two focused controls; they are not an exhaustive census or universal proof.
No profile-uniform compensation estimate for the signed E minor or induction-boundary strips is proved, and no guarded counterexample is found.
No claim is made about actual first-descent eligibility, current-p selector flags, selected payment, or the stronger MASS predicate.
